results.content: # The Impact of Corporate ESG Performance on Supply Chain Resilience: A Mediation Analysis Based on New Quality Productive Forces. The Sobel test confirmed that new quality productive forces play a significant mediating role between corporate ESG performance and supply chain resilience (indirect effect = 0.0045, Z = 2.225, p = 0.026). This study, based on data from Chinese A-share listed companies from 2015 to 2023, explores the impact of corporate ESG performance on supply chain resilience and examines the mediating role of new quality productive forces in this relationship.
